pride_data.title: Analysis of a BCOR internal tandem duplication in mouse embryonic stem cell to neuronal precursor differentiation
pride_data.projectDescription: To identify vPRC1.1 protein interactions in the context of a mutant BCOR-ITD subunit, we performed cross-linking followed by two-step affinity purification of BioTAP-tagged wildtype BCOR (BCOR-WT) or BCOR-ITD mutant protein in mES cells
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: mES cells were grown as monolayer cultures in 50 x 150-mm plates (~3x109 cells) for BioTAP-XL purification. Doxycyline was added (1 μg/mL) to 60 to 70% confluent culture to induce expression of the N-BioTAP–tagged wildtype BCOR or BCOR-ITD mutant cDNA for 24 hr. Steps of cell harvesting, formaldehyde cross-linking, chromatin preparation, affinity purification, input, and IP protein recovery, and data analysis were performed as described in Alekseyenko et al. 2015.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: data analysis were performed as described in Alekseyenko et al. 2015.
